subject: Jenoba Weapon Shop
text: The weapons and armorer's shops in Jenoba are located to the west, where players should buy one long sword.

evidence.quote:
The weapons and armorer's shops are to the west. Head there and buy only one 
long sword since you should already have one from the old cave.

subject: Merchant's Shop Bookshelf
text: Searching the bookshelf in the merchant's shop north of the weapons shop yields a hi potion.

evidence.quote:
Head north of 
the weapons shop and search the bookshelf in the merchant's shop for a hi 
potion.

subject: House Bookshelves
text: Searching the bookshelves in the house east of the stairs yields hi arrows and a bomb.

evidence.quote:
Next head east past the stairs to a house with a guy in it. Search the 
bookshelves for hi arrows and a bomb.

subject: Old Man
text: An old man in Jenoba sells information for 10 gold pieces worth of cider.

evidence.quote:
Speak to 
the old man, buy his cider for 10 gold pieces he'll share some info with you.

subject: Old Woman
text: An old woman in Jenoba shares valuable information if you answer yes and agree to buy her two ciders.

evidence.quote:
Talk to the old woman, answer yes to her question, and agree to buy her two 
ciders for valuable information.

subject: Jenoba
text: Exiting Jenoba and walking southeast leads to the Blue Tower.

evidence.quote:
When you're ready to continue, exit Jenoba 
and walk southeast and enter the blue tower.

subject: Chest
text: Entering the door to the east upon entering the Blue Tower leads to a chest containing a miracle guard.

evidence.quote:
Proceed east and enter
the door there to find a chest containing a miracle guard.

subject: Chest
text: Going west past the first door in the Blue Tower leads to another door with a chest containing a blue ring.

evidence.quote:
Next go west past 
the first door, where we find another door. Enter it to find a chest 
containing a blue ring.

subject: Chest
text: Taking the north stairs up in the Blue Tower and walking south leads to a chest containing a sweet water.

evidence.quote:
There's nothing in the center door so head north and 
take the stairs up. Walk south and open the chest for a sweet water.

subject: Wall Note
text: A note on the wall to the northwest in the Blue Tower tells the player to go to the red tower last.

evidence.quote:
There's a 
note on the wall to the northwest that tells you to go to the red tower last.

subject: Chest
text: Going through the east door and taking the stairs up leads west to a chest containing a hi potion.

evidence.quote:
Go through the east 
door. Take the stairs up and walk west to find a chest that contains a hi 
potion.

subject: Chest
text: Ascending the west stairs and following the path all the way around in the Blue Tower leads to a chest containing a hi magic.

evidence.quote:
Go up the west stairs first. Follow the path all the way around. Open 
the chest for a hi magic and then go up the stairs to examine the pedestal.

subject: Chest
text: Taking the east stairs, entering the door, and falling down the pit in the Blue Tower leads to a chest containing a revive.

evidence.quote:
Backtrack and take the east stairs this time. Enter the door and fall down the 
pit. Open the chest for a revive and go down the pit again.

subject: Chest
text: Falling down the second pit in the Blue Tower leads to a chest containing the green jade.

evidence.quote:
Open the chest for a revive and go down the pit again. Open the chest for 
the green jade.

subject: Jenoba
text: Exiting Jenoba, walking south across a bridge, and heading east leads to the Green Tower.

evidence.quote:
Then exit the
town and walk south across a bridge. Walk east once you cross the bridge and 
enter the green tower.

subject: Chest
text: Entering the west door of the Green Tower leads to a chest containing a green ring.

evidence.quote: First enter the west door to find a chest containing a green ring.

subject: Green Tower Inn
text: The east door of the Green Tower contains an inn that costs 150 Gold.

evidence.quote:
Inn --- 150 Gold

First enter the west door to find a chest containing a green ring. The east 
door contains an inn if you need it.

subject: Chest
text: Going up the west staircase and lowering the switch allows access to a chest containing a magic guard.

evidence.quote:
Now we have two staircases to 
choose from, go up the west one first. Lower the switch and open the chest for 
a magic guard.

subject: Chests
text: Taking the east stairs and going up the next flight leads to three chests containing an ex potion, a revive, and a broken red sapphire.

evidence.quote:
Now go up and east stairs. Go up the next flight of stairs you 
see and open the three chests for an ex potion, a revive, and a broken red 
sapphire that you don't keep.

subject: Chests
text: Going up another flight of stairs to the south leads to three chests containing a hi magic, an ex potion, and a revive.

evidence.quote:
Go back down and go up another flight of stairs 
to the south. Open the three chests for a hi magic, ex potion, and a revive.

subject: Chest
text: Opening the chest west of the south stairs yields a swing wing.

evidence.quote: Go back down and open the chest west of the south stairs for a swing wing.

subject: Switch
text: Raising the switch causes the stairs up on the east side to move.

evidence.quote:
Now 
backtrack to the switch and raise it. Go back up the east stairs and you'll 
see that the stairs up there have moved.

subject: Knight
text: A knight on the upper level of the Green Tower provides valuable information in exchange for 100 gold pieces.

evidence.quote:
Go up it and pay the knight 100 gold pieces 
for some valuable information.

subject: Green Tower
text: Exiting the Green Tower, walking south across the bridge, and heading northeast leads to the town of Ruan right next to the red tower.

evidence.quote:
Walk south and cross the bridge, then walk northeast and enter the town 
of Ruan which just happens to be right next to the red tower.

subject: Ruan Jeweler
text: The Jeweler in Ruan sells Emeralds for 200 Gold and Opals for 100 Gold.

subject: Ruan Inn
text: The inn in Ruan costs 10 Gold.

evidence.quote: Inn ------- 10 Gold

subject: Inn Bookshelf
text: Searching the bookshelf in the back of the inn in Ruan yields a hi potion.

evidence.quote: Enter the inn and search the bookshelf in back for a hi potion.

subject: Hut Bookshelves
text: Searching the bookshelves in the hut east of the inn yields a sweet water and a revive.

evidence.quote:
Next enter the 
hut to the east. Search the bookshelves there for a sweet water and a revive.

subject: Flower Patches
text: Searching the two plus-shaped flower patches east of the hut yields a power potion and an empty bottle.

evidence.quote:
Head east to the flowers and notice the two flower patches shaped like a "+" 
sign. Search them both for a power potion and an empty bottle.

subject: Jeweler Bookshelf
text: Searching the bookshelf inside the Jeweler's shop in Ruan yields an emerald.

evidence.quote:
Go north to the 
Jeweler and speak with the women in there. Then search the bookshelf for an 
emerald.

subject: House Bookshelf
text: Searching the bookshelf in the house with an old woman in Ruan yields a small knife.

evidence.quote:
Walk west and enter a house with an old woman in it. Search the 
bookshelf for a small knife.

subject: Medan
text: Warping to Medan and walking north leads into the Medan Mining Cave.

evidence.quote:
Exit and warp to 
Medan. Walk north and enter the cave.

subject: Chest
text: Going down either rope ladder at the entrance of Medan Mining Cave leads to a chest containing a foul water.

evidence.quote:
Go down either rope ladder and open 
the chest for a foul water.

subject: Chest
text: Descending the next ladder in Medan Mining Cave leads to a chest containing a sweet water.

evidence.quote:
Go down the next ladder and open the chest for a 
sweet water.

subject: Chest
text: Walking past the south door in Medan Mining Cave leads to a chest containing a bomb.

evidence.quote:
Walk past the door to the south and open the chest there for a 
bomb.

subject: Chests
text: Speaking to the old man opens a door to four chests containing an emerald, opal, 500 gold pieces, and a diamond ring.

evidence.quote:
Enter the door and speak with the old man. After the old man gives us 
what we cam for, enter the door the he just opened to find four chests. Open 
them to find an emerald, opal, 500 gold pieces, and a diamond ring.

subject: Golden Pawn
text: The Golden Pawn task can be accepted at the treasure hunters shop in Grenoble before entering the Old Cave.

evidence.quote:
Warp to Grenoble first and accept the "Golden Pawn" task 
at the treasure hunters shop. Exit the town and enter the Old Cave.

subject: Chests
text: Taking the elevator to the 5th floor of the Old Cave and walking south leads to two chests containing a smoke ball.

evidence.quote:
Enter the elevator, take it to the 5th floor, and then exit it. Walk south and 
open the two chests for a smoke ball.

subject: Chest
text: Entering the south door on the 5th floor of the Old Cave reveals five chests, one of which contains a cursed luck blade.

evidence.quote:
Enter the door to find five more chests. 
One of the chests contains the luck blade. Make sure not to equip it because 
it's cursed.

subject: Toxic Marsh
text: Searching the toxic marsh to the east on the 5th floor of the Old Cave yields an ex potion.

evidence.quote:
Search the toxic 
marsh to the east for a ex potion.

subject: Chest
text: Opening the chest near the toxic marsh on the 5th floor of the Old Cave yields a kite shield.

evidence.quote:
Open the chest for a kite shield which you 
should equip immediately.

subject: Chest
text: Going through the north door and then the easternmost door leads to a chest containing a hi bomb.

evidence.quote:
Enter the door to the north where we'll find three 
more chests and two more doors. Open the three chests and then go through the 
eastern most door. Open the chest there for a hi bomb.

subject: Chest
text: Going through the south door leads to three chests, one of which contains the battle axe.

evidence.quote:
Go through the door to the south to find three more chests. One of them 
contains the battle axe which you should equip immediately.

subject: Toxic Marsh
text: Searching the toxic marsh directly below the east door on the 5th floor of the Old Cave yields a revive.

evidence.quote:
Search the toxic marsh directly below the east door for a 
revive.

subject: Golden Pawn
text: Returning to Grenoble with the golden pawn yields a reward of 3,000 gold pieces.

evidence.quote:
Return to Grenoble, get your 3,000 gold pieces for the golden pawn, and then 
exit the town.

subject: Chests
text: Entering the westernmost door of the Red Tower and going up the stairs leads to two chests containing a high potion and a red ring.

evidence.quote:
Upon entering the tower you'll notice four doors. Enter the western most one 
first and go up the stairs. Open the two chests for a high potion and a red
ring.

subject: Chests
text: Entering the second door from the west in the Red Tower and descending the stairs leads to two chests containing a spell potion and a power potion.

evidence.quote:
Backtrack, enter the next door, and go down the stairs. Open the two
chests for a spell potion and a power potion.

subject: Chest
text: Taking either of the eastern doors up the stairs and entering the east door leads to a chest containing a float.

evidence.quote:
Backtrack once more, enter 
either of the two eastern doors, and take the stairs up. Now we have four 
directions to choose from. First enter the door to your east and open the 
chest for a float.

subject: Chests
text: Entering the west door on the upper level of the Red Tower leads to two chests containing a power gourd and a magic guard.

evidence.quote:
Enter the door to the west next and open the two chests for a power 
gourd and a magic guard.

subject: Chests
text: Heading south and going east in the Red Tower leads to two chests containing a hi potion and a hi magic.

evidence.quote:
Instead go east and open the two chests for a hi 
potion and a hi magic.

subject: Chests
text: Ascending the stairs from the hi potion and hi magic chests in the Red Tower leads to two chests containing a magic guard and a smoke ball.

evidence.quote:
Go up the stairs to find two more chests. Open them for 
a magic guard and a smoke ball.

subject: Chest
text: Going up the stairs through the previously ignored south door leads to a chest containing a hi potion.

evidence.quote:
Now enter the door we ignored. Go up the 
stairs it leads to and the next flight you see as well. Open the chest for a 
hi potion and then go back down.

subject: Dark Ghost
text: Dark Ghost is confronted in front of the pedestal at the top of the Red Tower.

evidence.quote:
Heal everyone 
and then speak to the monster in front of the pedestal. The battle against 
Dark Ghost should take you all of three minutes.

subject: Dark Ghost
text: Against Dark Ghost, Hero and Aguro should perform physical attacks, Lufia should continuously cast Bolt, and Jerin should focus on healing.

evidence.quote:
As usual, Hero and Aguro 
should launch constant physical attacks. Lufia should keep casting Bolt, while 
Jerin concentrates on healing.

subject: Chests
text: Re-entering the toxic marsh room in the Red Tower after defeating Dark Ghost reveals three chests containing the blue jade, a dragon egg, and a miracle.

evidence.quote:
After the battle fall of any side of the tower 
and then renter it. Go back to the room filled with toxic marsh. There are 
three chests in there now. Open them for the blue jade, a dragon egg, and a 
miracle.

subject: Blue Jade
text: Placing the blue jade on the pedestal at the top of the Blue Tower allows you to proceed to the green tower.

evidence.quote:
Walk all the way around to another staircase. Up it is the 
pedestal. Place the blue jade on it and then drop off the side of the tower. 
Our next destination is the green tower.
